ratings_why.fun: The clocks really interlock: Knockers feeding Deep Vigils, Netopir making the order of endings a puzzle, the shared lake's parity, and the Robber-Knight's paid silence against the stone.
ratings_why.distinct: A countdown tribe with a game-long counter is fresh in Bramble, but Hedgerow already has turns-in-slot clocks and Dripstone reads like Battlegrounds' 'played this game' counters.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken now that each Vigil ends once a turn; what is left are payoff ideas that would make it different, not better.

points.text: "Baby Dragon" and the Flood-Mark Reader both just read Dripstone. One could read Vigils ended this turn, so the quiet-house pulse build gets its own payoff.
The Robber-Knight's Swoop has nothing to do with the tribe. Let it grow for each quiet turn in a row, so the quiet house has a body that gets bigger.
Say on Mother Ribica whether her golden copy Discovers when played, as a triple does; the clutch build counts on it.
Two Comes-and-Goes Olms ending together give both Health and Attack, and a Scribe copy makes a third flip. Worth showing as a build, since it's the tribe's best hidden combo.

standouts.why: Brother Netopir turns reading order and timing into a puzzle: which Vigil ends last is now a choice you set up.
Guild Knocker cascades into Deep Vigils and Mother Ribica, and pairs with Kurents and Parkelj in ways you plan around.
The shared lake makes copies, Netopir repeats and Scribe copies change what the next flip gives.

weakest.why: "Baby Dragon" does one obvious job: gets bigger with Dripstone.
The Flood-Mark Reader is another flat Dripstone reader at a higher tier.
The Courier Bat's random neighbour leaves little to arrange.

flags.note: Knockers, lamps and Netopir repeating Mother Ribica can give a golden of your best unit every turn or two late.
The Seven-Year Sitter doubling a golden Olmling's per-Dripstone gain, repeated by Netopir, grows fast by round 12.
The Dragon Under the Earth counting as every tribe needs a check against every other tribe's text.
